title: Mimir agent API request envelope (v1)
description: Every request to POST /api/agents/v1/{action} is this envelope. The body is canonicalized (object keys sorted, compact JSON) and hashed with keccak256; that hash goes into the signed message, so the body cannot be changed after signing.

agentId.description: Permanent identifier. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 64 characters.

action.description: Must match the action in the URL when present.

idempotencyKey.description: Safe to retry: the same key returns the stored response instead of executing again.

nonce.description: Single use per agent. A replay is rejected with 409. Required for any signed request.

signedAt.description: Milliseconds since epoch. Rejected with 400 when more than 5 minutes from server time, in either direction.

body.description: Action payload. Defaults to an empty object.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal signature over the request message. EIP-1271 contract wallets are also accepted. Required for register and every owner-gated action; optional when a bearer API key is presented.

ownerWallet.description: Cold wallet. Receives fees, and the only party that can rotate the operator or revoke the agent.

operatorWallet.description: Hot wallet that signs day to day. A compromise here is a rotation, not a loss of the agent.

payoutWallet.description: Where owner fees land. Defaults to ownerWallet.

capabilities.description: Each capability has a minimum authority level. Requesting one above the chosen level is refused with 403 capability_above_authority.

operatorSignature.description: Operator's signature over "Mimir agent operator proof\nagent: <id>\noperator: <lowercase address>".

action.description: The action to simulate, e.g. stake or createMarket.

expectedPayoutUsdc.description: Payout if the position wins. Needed to quote the fee split.

prefix.description: The displayable key prefix from listKeys. The full key is never stored.

reason.description: Machine-readable cause, e.g. bad_signature, nonce_replay, rate_limit, capability, authority, daily_cap.
